description: Side-by-side nutrition and scoring comparison for 2–10 products by barcode. Returns a normalized table of energy (kcal/100g), fat, saturated fat, sugars, salt, protein, fiber, Nutri-Score, NOVA group, and Green-Score. Designed for "which of these cereals is healthiest?" or "compare these pasta brands" workflows. Missing nutrition data for any product is preserved as absent — comparisons are not imputed. A batch is not all-or-nothing: barcodes that resolve are returned even when others fail, with confirmed-missing barcodes listed in not_found and failed fetches listed separately in failed. Scores carry regional formula caveats. Data under ODbL 1.0 — cite Open Food Facts in downstream use.

barcodes.description: 2–10 barcodes to compare, returned as one row each in input order. Example: ["3017620422003", "7622210100146"].

items.description: Product barcode, digits only: 4–40 digits after any leading zeros.

name: off_compare_products

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `upstream_error`: Open Food Facts returns a 5xx other than 501 or 504, serves an HTML error page with a 2xx or 5xx status, or is unreachable for a barcode — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. `upstream_timeout`: Open Food Facts did not answer a barcode within the request deadline, or answered 408, 425, or 504 — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. `upstream_rejected`: Open Food Facts refuses a barcode with a 4xx other than 404, 408, 425, or 429, or with 501 Not Implemented — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. `rate_limited`: This server's own per-minute product budget is spent, or Open Food Facts answers 429 — reported in that barcode's failed entry rather than failing the call. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

failed.description: Barcodes whose fetch failed, with the per-barcode reason. Absent when every fetch completed. A barcode listed here is unknown, not absent from Open Food Facts — retry it with off_get_product before concluding anything about the product.

items.description: A single barcode whose fetch failed.

barcode.description: Barcode whose fetch failed, as provided in input.

error.description: What went wrong for this barcode and what to do about it.

reason.description: Declared failure reason — one of upstream_error, upstream_timeout, upstream_rejected, rate_limited.

not_found.description: Barcodes Open Food Facts answered for, confirming no contributor record exists. Not an error — the product may exist but not yet be entered. Never used for a fetch that failed.

items.description: Barcode with no contributor record, as provided in input.

products.description: Comparison rows in input order — one per barcode whose fetch completed, whether or not a record exists. Barcodes whose fetch failed have no row here; they appear in failed.

barcode.description: Barcode, echoed exactly as provided in input.

brands.description: Brand name(s), comma-separated. Absent when not yet entered.

completeness.description: Data completeness 0–1. Low values mean many fields are missing.

ecoscore_grade.description: Green-Score (formerly Eco-Score) environmental impact grade: "a-plus" (lowest impact), then "a" through "f"; "unknown" when the data it needs is missing, or "not-applicable" for product categories the score does not cover. Often absent.

energy_kcal_100g.description: Energy per 100g in kcal. Absent when not entered.

fat_100g.description: Total fat per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

fiber_100g.description: Dietary fiber per 100g in grams. Often absent.

found.description: False if the barcode has no contributor record.

nova_group.description: NOVA processing class (1–4). Absent when not assigned.

nutriscore_grade.description: Nutri-Score grade: "a" through "e", "unknown" when the nutrition data entered is not enough to compute it, or "not-applicable" for product categories the score does not cover. Absent when Open Food Facts sent none.

product_name.description: Product name. Absent when not yet entered by contributors.

proteins_100g.description: Protein per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

salt_100g.description: Salt per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

saturated_fat_100g.description: Saturated fat per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

sugars_100g.description: Total sugars per 100g in grams. Absent when not entered.

succeeded.description: Number of barcodes that resolved to a found product.

title: Compare Food Products Side-by-Side
